newsitem.title: CHINA: Dong-Jun yearly profit rises 73.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dong-Jun yearly profit rises 73.98 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Dong-Jun (Holdings), formerly Hop Ying International Ltd, is an importer and processor of leather.

The group underwent a major corporate restructing on October 10, 1996 whereby the leather manufacturing and trading businesses were disposed of to the former management and the property investment and development businesses were acquired from the existing management by the company.

As such, the directors consider that it is more meaningful to treat the company as the holding company of the existing corporate and business structure as if the group in its present form had been in existence for the two financial years ended March 31, 1997.

Accordingly, the pro forma combined financial statements of the company for the two financial years ended March 31, 1997, have been preared on the basis of the audited financial statements of the company and of its subsidiaries for the two financial years ended March 31, 1997 or since their respective dates of incorporation, where this is a shorter period, as if the current corporate and business structure had been in existence throughout the two financial years ended March 31, 1997.

The directors are in the opinion that the pro forma combined financial statements prepared on this basis more meaningfully present the results and state of affairs of the group as a whole in light of the corporate restructuring of October 1996.
Total dividend for year is two H.K. cents vs one cents.
